blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.
blocks.zh: 有效的视频代理不仅必须学会如何回答,而且还必须学会下一步看哪里。 将这种能力转移到较小的模型具有挑战性,因为每一项观察都有两个目的:支持一个答案并指导寻找进一步的证据。 文字描述可以捕捉目前可见的东西,同时省去后续获取所需的提示. 我们引入了Lententent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis(LARVA),这个框架通过共同学习的潜在推理和视觉观察来分泌多轮视频代理. 观察员不通过标题进行沟通,而是将紧凑的连续表示传递给选择下一个获取动作或产生最终答案的理性者. 至关重要的是,通过这一接口传播行动和回答监督,培训观察员交流有助于下游决策的信息。 观察重建与推理-分流相配合,从文字教师轨迹提供辅助监督. 通过视频理解的五个基准,LARVA以4B和7B骨干实现了强效. 在VideoHolmes,Video-MME,和LV Bench上,7B模型的成绩分别以5.1分,2.5分和3.7分的成绩超过了一个接受过相同教师轨迹培训的文字COT学生. 这些结果凸显出共同学习物剂如何代表证据并在分解视频理解能力时采取行动的价值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A video agent succeeds through a sequence of interdependent decisions: observe part of a video, reason about the available evidence, decide where to look next, and incorporate the new observation before answering. Recent agentic video systems implement this loop with tools that selectively inspect temporal regions ( Li et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . Each observation therefore affects both the interpretation of current evidence and the acquisition of future evidence. A missed temporal cue can redirect the search or cause premature stopping, leaving later reasoning without the evidence it needs. Distilling this capability into a smaller model requires preserving the coupling between observation, reasoning, and action throughout the interaction.
blocks.zh: 视频代理通过一系列相互依存的决定获得成功:观察视频的部分内容,现有证据的理由,决定下一步在哪里看,在回答之前纳入新的观察. 近期的代理视频系统用有选择地检查时区的工具实施这一循环(Li等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a年). 因此,每一项意见都影响到对现有证据的解释和未来证据的获取。 错失的时间提示可以改变搜索方向或导致过早停止,使以后的推理没有它所需要的证据. 将这种能力分解成一个较小的模式,需要在整个互动过程中保持观察、推理和行动之间的结合。

blocks.en: The representations passed around this loop determine what information can influence each decision. Many video agents express intermediate reasoning as textual chain-of-thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) ; modular systems also communicate observations through descriptions or query-specific responses ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . This repeatedly requires selecting which visual and reasoning details to verbalize. A description sufficient to identify an event may omit the temporal context needed to choose the next interval, leaving subsequent reasoning without direct access to that cue. Passing selected frames directly to the reasoner avoids textualization but adds visual tokens to its accumulating context ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . We ask: how can latent representations improve the complete observation–reasoning–action loop, from using current evidence to acquiring the evidence needed next?
blocks.zh: 围绕这个循环传递的表述决定了哪些信息可以影响每个决定. 许多视频代理将中间推理表现为文字思维链(CoT)(Wei等人,2022年);模块化系统也通过描述或特定查询回复来传达观察(Lin等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a). 这反复要求选择哪些视觉和推理细节来口头化. 足以识别某一事件的描述可能会省略选择下一个间隔所需的时间上下文,使随后的推理无法直接访问该提示. 将选定的帧直接传递到理子上可以避免文字化,但会在其累积上下文中添加视觉符号(张等,2026年;刘等,2026年b). 我们问:潜在的表述如何改善从利用现有证据到获得下一步所需的证据的完整观察-合理-行动循环?

blocks.en: Continuous latent representations provide a promising foundation. DyLaR combines latent perception and reasoning for video question answering, MACF communicates compact visual representations among video agents, and LatentRAG jointly learns latent reasoning and retrieval for iterative search ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zheng and Worring, 2026 ) . Our focus is jointly distilling latent reasoning and visual observations within a closed-loop video agent. Latent observations condition reasoning about the next acquisition; that acquisition determines the next visual input, whose latent representation feeds back into subsequent reasoning. Their value must therefore be assessed through both the decisions made along the trajectory and the final answer.
blocks.zh: 持续的潜在表述提供了一个有希望的基础。 DyLAR结合潜伏感知和推理进行视频提问解答,MACF在视频代理中交流紧凑的视觉表现,LatentRAG联合学习潜伏推理和检索,用于迭代搜索(Xia等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;郑和Worring,2026年). 我们的焦点是在闭路电视上 联合提炼潜在的推理和视觉观察 后期观测条件关于下一次获取的推理;该获取决定了下一次视觉输入,其潜在表达反馈到后续推理中. 因此,必须通过按照轨迹作出的决定和最后的答案来评估它们的价值。

blocks.en: Figure 1: When asked to compare the contestants’ attire, the CoT agent receives identical captions (“Gymnast in red, white, and blue”), confuses their identities, and skips ahead to the fourth contestant. LARVA samples around the transitions and correctly identifies no difference in attire.
blocks.zh: 图1:当被要求比较参赛者的着装时,CoT代理收到相同的字幕(“Gymnast in red, white, and blue”),混淆了他们的身份,并跳过第四名参赛者. LARVA在过渡周围采样,并正确识别无异于服装.

blocks.en: Learning this loop from textual teacher trajectories presents two challenges. First, the trajectories supervise reasoning traces, observations, and actions, but provide no direct targets for the latent states that replace the textual intermediates. Second, a representation useful in isolation may be ineffective in the loop: an observation latent may reconstruct a teacher description yet fail to support the reasoner’s next decision. Our key design principle is to jointly shape latent observations and reasoning by the downstream actions and answers they support . The continuous interface makes it possible to train how evidence is encoded together with how it is used, while textual supervision anchors the learned states to the teacher trajectory.
blocks.zh: 从文字教师轨迹中学习这个循环,提出了两个挑战. 首先,轨迹监督推理痕迹,观察,和行动,但没有为取代文字中间体的潜在状态提供直接目标. 第二,孤立的表述可能不会有效:一种潜在观察可能重建教师的描述,但却不能支持理性者的下一个决定。 我们的主要设计原则是通过下游行动及其支持的答案共同塑造潜在的观察和推理。 连续的接口使得可以训练证据是如何与如何使用一起编码的,而文字监督则将学到的状态锁定到老师的轨迹.

blocks.en: We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA) , which implements this principle through a jointly trained reasoner–observer architecture. At each round, the reasoner uses accumulated observations to compute latent reasoning states and select an explicit tool call or final answer. The observer encodes the requested frames into latent tokens that directly condition the next reasoning step. This closes the feedback loop between representing evidence and selecting further evidence, without decoding intermediate reasoning or observations into text. Each reasoning and observation block contains eight latent tokens in our main configuration, while raw visual processing remains in the observer.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis(LARVA),通过联合训练的理性-观察架构执行这一原则。 在每个回合,理性器使用累积的观测来计算潜在推理状态,并选择一个明确的工具调用或最终答案. 观察者将所请求的帧编码为直接制约下一个推理步骤的潜在符号. 这结束了代表证据和选择进一步证据之间的反馈循环,而没有将中间推理或观察解码为文字. 每个推理和观察区块都包含着我们主配置中的8个潜伏符号,而原始的视觉处理则留在观察者中.

blocks.en: To train LARVA, we replay teacher acquisition actions while replacing textual intermediates with generated latent states. Later action and answer losses propagate through the latent observation interface, so the observer receives supervision from how the reasoner uses its output. Observation reconstruction anchors visual content, while CoT-distribution alignment trains the combined latent context to induce next-reasoning predictions similar to those induced by teacher text in a frozen reference model. These objectives connect visual encoding, intermediate reasoning, and explicit decisions during training. The teacher fixes acquisitions during replay; at inference, the learned representations guide the student’s own acquisition loop.
blocks.zh: 为了训练LARVA,我们重新播放教师获取动作,同时用产生的潜伏状态取代文字中间体. 后期动作和解答损失通过潜在观测界面传播,因此观察者从理性者如何使用其输出接受监督. 观测重建锁定了视觉内容,而COT-分布调整则训练了结合的潜伏环境,以诱导下一个推理预测,类似于冻结参考模型中教师文本诱导的预测。 这些目标将视觉编码、中间推理和培训期间的明确决定联系起来。 教师在重播时修补收购;推论,学习表现指导学生自己的收购循环.

blocks.en: Our contributions advance both the design and learning of the complete video-agent loop: • A jointly learned latent observation–reasoning–action loop. We introduce LARVA, which makes the representation of acquired visual evidence a trainable part of the acquisition policy. Latent observations feed directly into latent reasoning, which selects the next explicit action and thereby determines the evidence available in subsequent rounds. This formulation couples learning how to represent evidence , how to reason over it , and where to look next within a single agentic framework. • Learning visual communication from downstream decisions. We develop a trajectory-distillation objective that trains what the observer communicates through the actions and answers its output supports. Action and answer supervision jointly shapes the observer and reasoner, while reconstruction and CoT-distribution alignment transfer textual supervision to their latent states. Joint training improves the latent/latent configuration by 5.3–7.2 percentage points across three diagnostic benchmarks, taking it from below the textual baseline to the strongest evaluated representation configuration (Table 2 ). • Stronger video understanding with acquisition gains across answerers. LARVA improves over CoT students distilled from the same teacher trajectories on all five benchmarks with both 4B and 7B backbones, gaining 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 points on VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench with the 7B model (Table 1 ). Its acquisition trajectories also improve accuracy with each of three fixed terminal answerers across all three diagnostic benchmarks; a fixed 27B visual answerer gains 1.7–4.2 points (Table 4 ). These results connect stronger final answers to improvements in the evidence-acquisition process itself.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献推动了完整的视频代理循环的设计和学习: —— 一个共同学到的潜在观察-理性-行动循环。 我们引入了LARVA,它使得所获取的视觉证据的表述成为收购政策中可以训练的一部分. 后期观测直接反馈到潜在的推理中,它选择下一个明确的动作,从而决定了以后各轮中可用的证据. 这种配方的夫妇学习如何代表证据,如何解释证据,在单一的代理框架内下看哪里。 • 从下游决策中学习视觉交流。 我们开发了一个轨迹分散目标, 用来训练观察者通过动作交流的东西 并回答其输出支持。 行动和回答监督共同塑造观察者和理性,而重建和共同分配协调则将文字监督转移到潜在的状态。 联合培训使潜在/相对的组合在三个诊断基准中提高了5.3-7.2个百分点,从低于文字基线到最强的评价代表配置(表2)。 • 加强视频了解,使回答者获得收益。 LARVA在使用4B和7B两个主干线的所有五个基准上从同样的教师轨迹中提炼出来的CoT学生比LARVA有所改善,在VideoHolmes,Video-MME和LV Bench上获得了5.1,2.5和3.7分(表1)。 它的获取轨迹也提高了所有三个诊断基准的三个固定终端答录器的准确性;一个固定的27B视觉答录器得到1.7-4.2分(表4). 这些成果将改进证据获取过程本身的更强有力的最后答案联系起来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Agentic Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 代理视频理解

blocks.en: Because only a small fraction of frames in a long video is typically relevant to a query, recent work replaces exhaustive encoding with agents that iteratively decide what evidence to acquire. VideoSeek follows a think–act–observe loop with multi-granularity observation tools ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and EVA trains a single multimodal large language model (MLLM) with supervised and reinforcement learning to plan what to watch, acquire frames, and reflect on the resulting evidence ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These systems differ in how reasoning and perception are coupled. Unified agents such as EVA interpret the acquired frames directly within the reasoning model. Reasoner–observer designs such as LensWalk and VideoSeek instead let a language-model reasoner choose the temporal range and sampling strategy, while a vision-language observer returns evidence ( Li et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Other systems decompose the task further: LongVideoAgent coordinates grounding and vision agents ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , VideoExplorer places a text-only reasoning model above a multimodal toolkit ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and VideoARM accumulates tool outputs in a hierarchical memory ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . Many of these systems are training-free.
blocks.zh: 由于长视频中只有一小部分帧通常与查询相关,最近的工作用反复决定要获取哪些证据的代理取代了详尽的编码. VideoSeek遵循一种思维–act–observation 循环与多引力观测工具(Lin et al., 2026),EVA训练一种单一的多模式大型语言模型(MLLM),有监督强化的学习,以规划什么可以观看,获取帧,并反思由此形成的证据(Zhang等人, 2026年). 这些系统在推理和感知的结合方式上有所不同. EVA等统一代理直接在推理模型内解释获得的帧. Reasoner – Observer 设计如 LensWalk 和 VideoSeek 转而让语言模型的Reasoner 选择时间范围和采样策略,而视觉语言观察者则返回证据(Li等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年). 其他系统进一步分解任务:Long Video Agent 坐标定位和视觉代理(Liu等人,2026a) , Video 探索者将仅文本推理模型置于多模式工具包之上(Yuan等人,2025年),VideoARM将工具输出积累在分级内存中(Yin等人,2026年). 其中许多系统没有培训。

blocks.en: Across these designs, reasoning and perception communicate through explicit interfaces. Intermediate reasoning is generated as text, and modular observers typically convert visual evidence into textual descriptions for the reasoner ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Language is interpretable and convenient for combining independently developed models, but it requires sequential verbalization and projects high-dimensional visual evidence into a discrete representation before that evidence can influence subsequent decisions. LARVA retains the reasoner–observer decomposition but learns a continuous interface between the two roles.
blocks.zh: 在这些设计中,推理和感知通过明确的界面进行交流. 中间推理是作为文字产生的,模块化观察者通常会将视觉证据转化为文字描述,以说明理由(Liu等人,2026a); Li等人,2026年). 语言是可解释的,可以方便地结合独立开发的模型,但是它需要相继的口头化,并且将高维视觉证据投射成一种离散的表达方式,然后这些证据才能影响后来的决定. LARVA保留了causeer–observer分解,但学习了两个角色之间的连续接口.

blocks.en: 2.2 Latent Reasoning and Communication
blocks.zh: 2.2 事后解释和沟通

blocks.en:
Latent reasoning replaces decoded reasoning steps with continuous hidden states. Coconut feeds the last hidden state back as the next input embedding and progressively replaces textual CoT steps through a curriculum ( Hao et al., 2024 ) , while CODI distills explicit CoT into a compact latent sequence by aligning teacher and student hidden states ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . In the visual domain, LaViT supervises latent visual thoughts with a teacher’s visual semantics and attention patterns ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and DyLaR combines separate perception and reasoning latents for video question answering over a fixed set of sampled frames ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . Continuous representations have also been used for communication and interaction. MACF trains local video agents to pass compact latents to a coordinator ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ; ALAR learns latent reasoning from action supervision and switches adaptively between latent and explicit reasoning across tool-use turns ( Jung et al., 2026 ) ; and LatentRAG jointly trains a large language model (LLM) and a retriever for iterative search with latent reasoning and queries ( Zheng and Worring, 2026 ) .
LARVA differs from them by jointly distilling latent reasoning and latent visual observations within a closed-loop video agent, so that action and answer losses shape the observation interface and the reasoning states.
blocks.zh:
Latet推理用连续隐藏状态取代解码推理步骤. 椰子将最后一个隐藏状态反馈回,作为下一个输入嵌入,并通过一个课程逐渐取代文字的CoT步骤(Hao等人,2024年),而CODI通过调整师生隐藏状态,将明确的CoT蒸馏成紧凑的潜伏序列(Shen等人,2025年)。 在视觉领域,LaViT用教师的视觉语义和注意力模式来监督潜伏的视觉思维(Wu等人,2026年),DyLaR将视频问题回答的单独感知和推理潜伏结合到一组固定的样本框上(Xia等人,2026年). 持续陈述也被用于沟通和互动。 MACF培训本地的视频代理将紧凑的潜伏物传递给一名协调员(Chen等人,2026年);ALAR从动作监督中学习潜伏的推理,并适应地将潜伏的推理和明确的推理在工具使用转弯之间切换(Jung等人,2026年);LatentRAG联合培训一个大型语言模型(LLM)和一个带潜伏推理和查询的检索器(Zhing和Worring,2026年)。
LARVA与它们不同之处在于,在一个闭路视频代理中共同提炼潜在的推理和潜在的视觉观测,这样动作和回答损失就决定了观察界面和推理状态.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of LARVA. (a) During multi-round inference, the latent agent selects video acquisitions and integrates compact latent observations to guide subsequent tool calls and produce an answer. (b) Joint training combines observation reconstruction ℒ obs \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{obs}} , CoT distribution alignment ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{align}} , and action supervision ℒ act \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}} . The alignment loss uses a frozen CoT agent to match text- and latent-conditioned reasoning distributions, supervising both the latent agent and observer.

blocks.en: LARVA learns a continuous interface between visual observation and sequential decision making. A reasoner selects which video evidence to acquire, and an observer encodes the selected frames into latent tokens that condition subsequent decisions. We distill this interaction from teacher trajectories using action and answer supervision, together with auxiliary observation reconstruction and CoT-distribution alignment. The central design is to train the observation interface jointly with the reasoner, so that its representations support both interpreting the evidence and decision-making.
blocks.zh: LARVA学习视觉观察和顺序决策的连续接口. 一个理由选择了要获取的视频证据,一个观察者将选定的帧编码成潜在的符号,从而制约了随后的决定. 我们利用动作和回答监督 以及辅助观测重建 和协同分配 来提炼这种互动 中央设计是将观测界面与理性器联合训练,使其表达支持解释证据和决策.

blocks.en: 3.4 Inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 推论

blocks.en: At inference, the reasoner generates a latent reasoning block and then selects a tool call or produces the final answer. Each tool call acquires frames for the observer, whose latent output conditions the following decision. The loop ends when the reasoner answers or reaches the acquisition limit, after which it answers using the accumulated context. Our main configuration uses 8 latent tokens per reasoning and observation block and permits at most eight acquisition rounds. Neither textual CoT nor textual observations are decoded during inference; tool calls and final answers remain textual.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments evaluate LARVA as a complete observation–reasoning–action loop. We first test whether it improves video understanding over students distilled from the same teacher trajectories. We then examine the contributions of latent reasoning, latent observations, and joint optimization, before evaluating inference cost and the usefulness of the acquired evidence. Answerer swaps, a human assessment of incremental evidence, and teacher-trajectory comparisons provide complementary views of acquisition behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验评价LARVA是一个完整的观察-理性-行动循环. 我们首先测试它是否提高了学生对同一教师轨迹的视频理解度。 然后,我们先审查潜在推理、潜在观察和联合优化的贡献,然后评价推断成本和所获证据的有用性。 Answers互换,人对增量证据的评估,以及师-导比较,为获取行为提供了互补的观点.

blocks.en: We generate 20,000 interaction trajectories from VideoMarathon ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , the VideoHolmes training set ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , and LongVideo-Reason ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , filtering trajectories with incorrect final answers or invalid tool calls. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) serve as the teacher reasoner and observer. We instantiate LARVA with Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , sharing a backbone with separate reasoner and observer LoRA adapters. The main configuration uses eight latent tokens per reasoning and observation block and at most eight acquisition rounds. Initialization, optimization settings, and acquisition tools are detailed in Appendix A.5 .

(Quen Team, 2026 )担任教师的理性者和观察者. 我们用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等人,2025年b)和Qune3-VL-4B(Bai等人,2025年a)对LARVA进行即时分析,用单独的理性器和观察员LORA适配器共享骨干. 主配置每个推理和观察块使用8个潜伏符号,最多使用8个获取回合. 初始化、优化设置和获取工具详见附录A.5。

blocks.en: We report accuracy on VideoHolmes ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , excluding Video-MME captions from model input. CoT Policy learns the teacher’s reasoning, tool calls, and answers; Direct Policy omits the reasoning traces. Both use the same distilled textual observer and source trajectories, controlling for the supervision data. EVA ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , VideoMind ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , DyLaR ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , and MACF ( Chen et al., 2026 ) provide broader comparisons but differ in architecture and training. Unless otherwise stated, diagnostic experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
blocks.zh: 我们报告VideoHolmes的准确性(Cheng等人,2025年),Video-MME (Fu等人,2025年),LV Bench(Wang等人,2025年),Long Video Bench(Wu等人,2024年),MLVU(Zhou等人,2024年),不包括模型输入的视频-MME字幕. 代码 政策学习老师的推理,工具调用和答案;直接政策省略推理痕迹. 两者都使用相同的蒸馏文本观察器和源轨迹,控制监督数据. EVA (张等, 2026)., VideoMind (Liu等人,2026年b),DyLAR(Xia等人,2026年),MACF(Chen等人,2026年)提供更广泛的比较,但在建筑和培训上有所不同. 除非另有说明,诊断实验使用Quen2.5-VL-7B.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results. Accuracy (%) on five video-understanding benchmarks. Teacher models are listed for reference. CoT Policy and Direct Policy are controlled students distilled from the same teacher trajectories as LARVA.
blocks.zh: 表1:主要结果。 五个视频理解基准的准确性(%). 师范模型列出参考. COT政策和直接政策是由LARVA一样的教师轨迹提炼出来的受控学生.

blocks.en: LARVA outperforms the CoT student on all five benchmarks with both backbones (Table 1 ). With Qwen2.5-VL-7B, it improves accuracy from 39.2 to 44.3 on VideoHolmes, 59.9 to 62.4 on Video-MME, and 41.3 to 45.0 on LVBench: gains of 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points , respectively. It also gains 1.3 points on LongVideoBench and 0.4 on MLVU. With Qwen3-VL-4B, the corresponding gains are 5.5, 1.9, 2.2, 2.4, and 1.8 points. The unweighted mean improvement over the five benchmarks is 2.6 points for 7B and 2.8 points for 4B.
blocks.zh: LARVA在所有5个基准上都比COT学生表现优异,有两种骨干(表1). 使用Quen2.5-VL-7B,其精度在VideoHolmes上从39.2升至44.3,在Video-MME上从59.9升至62.4,在LV Bench上从41.3升至45.0:增益分别为5.1,2.5和3.7个百分点. 它还在LongVideo Bench上获得了1.3分,在MLVU上获得了0.4分. 使用Quen3-VL-4B,相应的增益为5.5,1.9,2.2,2.4,1.8分. 5个基准的未加权平均改善为7B2.6分,4B2.8分。

blocks.en: LARVA also achieves the highest reported accuracy within each backbone group in Table 1 . For the 7B backbone, it exceeds the strongest listed alternative by 3.3 points on VideoHolmes, 2.2 on Video-MME, and 1.7 on LVBench. The Direct Policy falls below the CoT student on every benchmark with both backbones, whereas LARVA improves on CoT while replacing textual intermediates with learned latent states. Together, these comparisons support learning intermediate representations for the acquisition loop rather than simply omitting intermediate reasoning.
blocks.zh: LARVA还实现了表1中每个骨干组中报告的最高准确度. 对于7B骨干,它比列出的最强的替代品在VideoHolmes上超过了3.3分,在Video-MME上超过了2.2分,在LV Bench上超过了1.7分. 直接政策在每个基准上都低于COT学生的水平,而LARVA则在COT上有所改进,同时以学习到的潜在状态取代文字中间体。 这些比较加在一起,支持学习中间表达,用于获取循环,而不是简单地省略中间推理.

blocks.en: 4.3 Representation and Training Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 代表和培训问题

blocks.en: Table 2: Contributions of latent reasoning and observation. Accuracy (%) of students with textual or latent reasoning and observation interfaces, with (✓) or without (✗) joint training of the reasoner and observer, on Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) . All variants use the same training examples and tools.
blocks.zh: 表2:潜在推理和观察的贡献。 具有文字或潜在推理和观察界面的学生的准确性(%),其中(✓)或不(✗)对理智者和观察者进行关于Quen2.5-VL-7B的联合培训(Bai等人,2025b)。 所有变体都使用相同的培训实例和工具.

blocks.en: Replacing textual reasoning with latent reasoning while retaining textual observations raises accuracy by 3.5, 2.0, and 2.3 points on VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench (Table 2 ). Full LARVA further improves on this variant by 1.6, 0.5, and 1.4 points. The strongest configuration therefore combines latent reasoning with jointly learned latent observations, rather than obtaining its full benefit from latent reasoning alone.
blocks.zh: 用潜在的推理取代文字推理,同时保留文字观察,在VideoHolmes、Video-MME和LV Bench上提高了3.5、2.0和2.3点的准确性(表2)。 Full LARVA在这个变体上进一步提高了1.6,0.5和1.4分. 因此,最强的组合将潜在推理与共同学到的潜在观察结合起来,而不是仅仅从潜在推理中充分受益。

blocks.en: Latent observations are not sufficient by themselves: without joint training, the textual-reasoning/latent-observation variant scores 38.6, 59.3, and 40.7, below the fully textual student on all three benchmarks. Joint training raises these scores to 43.5, 60.8, and 42.0. The effect is larger when both interfaces are latent: joint optimization improves accuracy from 37.4 to 44.3, 55.2 to 62.4, and 39.7 to 45.0, gaining 6.9, 7.2, and 5.3-point .
blocks.zh: 初步观察本身是不够的:没有联合训练,文字推理/相对观察变式在所有三个基准上都得分38.6、59.3和40.7,低于完全文字学生。 联合培训的分数提高到43.5、60.8和42.0。 当两个接口都具有潜伏性时,其效果更大:联合优化提高了精度,从37.4提高到44.3、55.2提高到62.4、39.7提高到45.0,提高了6.9、7.2和5.3点。

blocks.en: For the non-joint latent/latent variant, we first train the latent reasoner with textual observations, then freeze it and train the latent observer with the objectives in Section 3 . Its weaker performance highlights the challenge of fitting a continuous observation interface to a fixed receiver trained on text. Joint training instead allows the reasoner and observer to adapt together, turning the latent/latent configuration from below the textual baseline into the strongest evaluated variant.
blocks.zh: 对于非联合潜在/相对变量,我们首先用文字观察来训练潜在原因器,然后将其冻结,并训练潜在观察者实现第3节的目标。 其性能较弱,突出表明了将连续观测接口安装在受过文本培训的固定接收器上的挑战。 相反,联合培训使理性者和观察者能够共同适应,将潜在的/相对的配置从文字基线以下转变为最强的评价变量。

blocks.en: Increasing observation or reasoning latents from one to eight generally improves accuracy, with smaller gains between six and eight. Very short observation sequences are particularly restrictive, supporting sufficient capacity for visual communication. Appendix A.7 provides the complete sweep and analysis (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 从1到8的观测或推理潜伏性增加,一般提高准确性,6到8的增益较小。 极短的观测序列特别有限制性,支持足够的视觉通信能力. 附录A.7提供了完整的扫描和分析(图3)。

blocks.zh: 4.4 推论费用

blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes average inference cost over VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench. LARVA records 8.2 seconds per question compared with 48.3 for CoT Policy and 39.0 for Direct Policy, corresponding to 5.9 × \times and 4.8 × \times speedups in the reported setting. Relative to CoT, average acquisition turns decrease from 4.8 to 3.2 and processed frames from 112.5 to 75.9, reductions of 33.3% and 32.5%, respectively. Thus, its higher accuracy is accompanied by less visual processing on average.
blocks.zh: 表3概述了VideoHolmes、Video-MME和LV Bench的平均推论费用。 LARVA记录每个问题8.2秒,而COT Policy为48.3秒,Direct Policy为39.0秒,相对应的是5.9xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 与《公约》相比,平均购置量从4.8降至3.2,加工框架从112.5降至75.9,分别减少33.3%和32.5%。 因此,它的精确度较高,同时平均视觉处理较少。

blocks.en: LARVA also reduces the reported intermediate reasoning positions from 1752.5 to 12.8 and observation positions received by the reasoner from 1457.2 to 577.4. These counts describe the reasoner’s interface; the observer still incurs the cost of encoding selected frames. LARVA has the lowest reported latency among the listed systems, but frame counts, token types, architectures, and API overhead differ across systems. We therefore interpret these measurements as the cost of each complete configuration rather than an isolated estimate of the savings from latent representations.
blocks.zh: LARVA还把所报告的中间推理位置从1752.5降至12.8,将理智者收到的观察位置从1457.2降至577.4. 这些计数可以描述解释器的界面; 观察者仍然承担着编码选定帧的费用. LARVA在所列出的系统中的延迟度最低,但帧计数,令牌类型,架构,以及API的间接费用各系统不同. 因此,我们将这些计量解释为每个完整的配置的成本,而不是对潜在表述节省的费用的单独估计。

blocks.en: 4.5 Evidence Acquisition Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 证据获取分析

blocks.en: Table 4: Evidence quality via answerer swaps. Trajectories are generated by the CoT or latent student; at the terminal decision, the acquired evidence is passed to the listed answerer.
blocks.zh: 表4:通过回答交换提供的证据质量。 轨迹由CoT或潜伏学生生成;在终极决定时,获得的证据传递给列出的回答者.

blocks.en: To assess whether gains extend beyond LARVA’s own answer decoder, we replace the answerer when the acquisition policy stops or exhausts its action budget. Table 4 compares CoT and LARVA trajectories with each terminal answerer held fixed. LARVA trajectories improve accuracy in all nine answerer–benchmark comparisons. With the CoT answerer, the gains are 4.4, 1.2, and 0.2 points; with the latent answerer, they are 1.5, 2.4, and 3.5 points. A fixed 27B visual answerer gains 1.7, 4.2, and 2.6 points , respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了评估收益是否超出LARVA自己的解码器,当收购政策停止或用尽其行动预算时,我们取代解码器。 表4将COT和LARVA的轨迹与每个固定的终端回答器进行比较。 LARVA 轨迹提高了所有9个答题-基准比较的准确性. 使用CoT答录器,得分为4.4分,1.2分,0.2分;使用潜在答录器,得分为1.5分,2.4分,3.5分. 一个固定的27B视觉答录器分别获得1.7,4.2和2.6分.

blocks.en: The benefit to a separate visual answerer supports the usefulness of LARVA’s selected evidence beyond compatibility with its own latent answerer. This complements the end-to-end results: improvements persist when terminal answering is held fixed. The swap experiment evaluates complete acquisition trajectories, whose realized lengths and frame counts may differ; the human study below targets incremental evidence under a fixed additional-frame budget.
blocks.zh: 一个单独的视觉解答器的好处支持了LARVA所选证据的有用性,超越了与自身潜在解答器的兼容性. 这补充了端到端的成果:当终端答复被固定时,情况继续改善。 互换实验评价了完整的购置轨迹,其实现的长度和帧数可能不同;以下的人类研究针对固定的额外框架预算下的增量证据.

blocks.en: We conduct a paired comparison between full LARVA and the latent-reasoning/textual-observation ablation, both using Qwen2.5-VL-7B, on 100 held-out questions. Each model receives the same 64-frame Overview and makes one additional Skim/Focus call returning 16 frames. This fixes the initial visual coverage and the additional-frame budget, focusing the comparison on the usefulness of the next acquisition.
blocks.zh: 我们用Qun2.5-VL-7B对100个搁置问题进行全LARVA和潜在合理/文字观察的对比。 每个型号都收到相同的64帧概览,并让一个额外的Skim/Focus呼叫返回16帧. 这确定了最初的视觉覆盖面和额外框架预算,重点是下一次购置的效用。

blocks.en: Two independent judges assess anonymized, randomly ordered acquisition sets for new answer-relevant clues absent from the Overview. Model identities, reasoning traces, and answers are hidden; repeated clues do not count. Judgments are Yes, No, or Uncertain, and disagreements are adjudicated. Appendix A.6 details the reference checklist and annotation procedure.
blocks.zh: 两位独立法官评估匿名,随机订购的获取集,以获取"概览"中缺失的与答案相关的新线索. 模型身份,推理痕迹和答案被隐藏;重复的线索不计数. 判决是 " 是 " 、 " 不 " 或 " 不确定 " ,对分歧作出裁决。 附录A.6详细列出了参考清单和注释程序。

blocks.en: Table 5: Human assessment of incremental evidence. Evidence-gain rate is adjudicated Yes divided by 100 questions. Uncertain cases remain in the denominator and are reported as counts. Both models receive the same 64-frame Overview and a 16-frame additional acquisition budget.
blocks.zh: 表5:对增量证据的人力评估。 裁定证据收益率 是除百问. 不确定情况仍留在分母中,作为计数报告。 这两个模式都得到同样的64框架概览和16框架的额外购置预算。

blocks.en: Full LARVA yields new answer-relevant evidence on 35% of questions, compared with 15% for the latent-reasoning/textual-observation and 11% for text reasoning and latent observation. Full LARVA produces up to 24-percentage-point gain under the same additional-frame budget (Table 5 ). Uncertain cases are retained in the denominator for both models. This result complements the answerer swaps by showing that the full model more often selects frames containing an additional useful clue, independently of its final-answer generation. This measures the first acquisition after a shared Overview; it does not measure evidence coverage across an entire trajectory.
blocks.zh: 完整的LARVA为35%的问题提供了新的与答案相关的证据,而潜在合理/文字观察为15%,文本推理和潜在观察为11%。 根据同一额外框架预算,LARVA的全额收益高达24个百分点(表5)。 两个模型的分母中都保留了不确定的情况。 这个结果补充了解答器的互换,显示整个模型更经常地选择包含额外有用线索的帧,独立于其最终解答生成. 这衡量的是共享概览之后的第一次获取;它没有衡量整个轨道的证据覆盖范围。

blocks.en: LARVA exceeds both textual students in tool-sequence similarity, temporal IoU, and optional-tool agreement across all three diagnostic benchmarks. Relative to CoT, its tool-sequence scores increase by 4.6, 0.8, and 1.3 points, and temporal IoU by 1.2, 2.3, and 2.0 points. These results support better transfer of teacher acquisition behavior, complementing the answerer swaps that assess the usefulness of acquired evidence. Appendix A.8 gives the metric definitions and complete results (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: LARVA在工具序列相似性,时间IoU,以及所有三个诊断基准的可选工具协议中都超过了两个文本学生. 相对于CoT,其工具序列分数增加了4.6分,0.8分,1.3分,时间IoU则增加了1.2分,2.3分,2.0分. 这些结果支持更好的教师获取行为的转移,补充了评估获取证据的实用性的答案交换. 附录A.8列出了计量定义和完整结果(表6)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LARVA, a framework that jointly learns latent reasoning and latent visual observations for agentic video understanding. By combining action supervision, observation reconstruction, and CoT distribution alignment, LARVA learns compact intermediate representations that support multi-round evidence acquisition and answer generation. Experiments across three benchmarks show that LARVA outperforms existing methods while reducing inference latency. Further analyses demonstrate stronger evidence-gathering capability than textual distilled students and closer agreement with the teacher’s acquisition behavior. These results highlight joint latent training as an effective approach to building accurate and efficient video agents.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LARVA,这个框架共同学习潜在的推理和潜在的视觉观察,以了解代理视频. LARVA通过结合动作监督,观察重建,以及CoT分配对齐,学习了支持多轮取证和解答生成的紧凑的中间表示. 跨越三个基准的实验表明,LARVA在减少推论延迟性的同时,超越了现有方法. 进一步的分析显示,证据收集能力比文字提炼的学生更强,更接近教师的获取行为。 这些成果突出表明,联合潜在培训是建立准确、高效视频代理的有效办法。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: LARVA has several limitations. First, it operates on sampled visual frames and does not process audio. It therefore cannot directly use dialogue, environmental sounds, or other acoustic cues, limiting its applicability to questions requiring audiovisual understanding.
blocks.zh: LARVA有几种限制. 首先,它运行在抽样的视觉帧上,不处理音频. 因此,它不能直接使用对话、环境声音或其他声调提示,将其适用范围限制在需要视听理解的问题。

blocks.en: Second, training relies on teacher-generated trajectories and a frozen CoT student for distribution alignment. These supervision sources may contain errors or suboptimal acquisition decisions that LARVA can inherit. Moreover, training on teacher trajectories may provide limited coverage of the histories encountered during student execution, particularly after an incorrect acquisition.
blocks.zh: 第二,培训依靠教师产生的轨迹和一个冷冻的CoT学生进行分配对齐。 这些监督来源可能含有LARVA可以继承的错误或次最佳收购决定. 此外,关于教师轨迹的培训可能有限地涵盖学生处决时遇到的历史,特别是在不正确获得之后。

blocks.en: Finally, compact latent representations are less directly interpretable than textual reasoning and observations. Although tool calls and acquired frames remain inspectable, identifying whether a failure originates in visual compression, reasoning, or evidence selection is more difficult. Compression may also discard fine-grained details needed for some questions.
blocks.zh: 最后,紧凑的潜在表述不如文字推理和意见直接解释。 尽管工具调用和获得的帧仍然可以检查,但识别失败是否源于视觉压缩,推理或证据选择更困难. 压缩还可能丢弃一些问题所需的精细细节。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies efficient evidence acquisition for video understanding using existing research datasets. Video agents may produce incorrect interpretations, inherit biases from their training data and teacher models, or overlook relevant visual evidence. Their outputs therefore require appropriate human oversight in consequential applications. Any use or release of video data and derived training trajectories should respect applicable dataset licenses, privacy requirements, and usage restrictions.
blocks.zh: 这项工作利用现有研究数据集,研究有效获取证据以了解视频。 视频代理可能会产生不正确的解释,继承其培训数据和教师模型的偏见,或者忽略相关的视觉证据. 因此,它们的产出需要适当的人力监督。 视频数据和衍生培训轨迹的任何使用或发布都应遵守适用的数据集许可证、隐私要求和使用限制。

blocks.en: A.1 Observation Tools
blocks.zh: A.1 观察工具

blocks.en: We adopt the Overview , Skim , and Focus interface of VideoSeek ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and use the same tools for our controlled textual and latent students. Overview uniformly samples 64 frames across the full video. Skim samples 16 frames from a reasoner-specified interval and asks the observer to search for query-relevant cues. Focus also samples 16 frames from a specified interval, with a query targeting a concrete sub-question. These operations support global exploration and progressively targeted inspection while keeping acquisition actions externally executable.

blocks.en: We conduct a paired comparison between full LARVA and the latent-reasoning/textual-observation ablation, both using Qwen2.5-VL-7B, on 100 held-out questions. Each model receives the same 64-frame Overview and makes one additional Skim/Focus call returning 16 frames. This fixes the initial visual coverage and the additional-frame budget, focusing the comparison on the usefulness of the next acquisition.

blocks.en: Two independent judges inspect the question, a reference evidence checklist, the shared Overview, and anonymized acquisition sets presented in randomized order. Repeated clues do not count as new evidence. Disagreements are adjudicated.
